segments.text: Yura was Keisuke's wife, is Mashiro's mother and Mitsuru's sister-in-law. She comes from a difficult, strict and violent family: her father would come home late at night to beat her mother who forgot her problems with alcoholism. Her life was all stress and Yura had no trusted friends to live with.

One day as she forgot her life by walking outside, a man who looked at her with concern asked her what was wrong and she confided in this perfect stranger. The stranger then put her in his truck and showed her for a week the most beautiful landscapes he knew, telling her that she had to keep hope. That's how she met Keisuke.
When Keisuke died, Yura was now alone with a newborn baby. She really didn't expect her younger brother-in-law to come and give her back the desire to live, as Keisuke had done for her before.
Mashiro, Yura's daughter and Mitsuru's niece, some years after Keisuke's death. She is now in kindergarten before moving on to elementary school.
She is very kind and adorable and loves her mother and Ojii-san very much and she really considers Mitsuru as her real father, even writing a poem to express her love for him.

Mitsuru is Keisuke's younger brother, he considers him as if he were his real father. A few years earlier, Mitsuru was in big trouble and his older brother decided to look after him. During all his years in college, Keisuke kept supporting him, telling him that he was and was doing his pride and when Mitsuru found a job, his older brother was overjoyed. However, his brother then told him that he had established a relationship with a certain Yura and that he had decided to propose to her.

Mitsuru was very happy for his brother, even though he knew that this news also announced the beginning of a life of loneliness for him. Unfortunately, a few months later after Mashiro's birth, Keisuke had a car accident and died in the ambulance that took him to the hospital. Very sad for his brother and his nascent family, Mitsuru decided not to let fate dictate their lives and decided to give back to his sister-in-law and niece what his brother had given him before, a family.

Keisuke is Mitsuru's older brother, he was running a truck driver business. Years ago when Mitsuru was not yet an university student, he took him on his wing so that his little brother could quietly take off under his protection. His little brother is and makes him proud and after years of study, Mitsuru became someone and at the same time Keisuke met and bonded with Yura with whom he was going to marry.
A few months later, Keisuke has a car accident and died in the ambulance that took him to the hospital, leaving behind him his wife Yura and his newly born daughter, Mashiro.
Mashiro, Yura's baby and Mitsuru's niece, a few months after Keisuke's death when she was a baby and therefore never knew him.
